It tells Michelle how to run the close, what artifacts to produce, who may certify, and what must already exist before the first live close. It does not replace Row 11 (chart of accounts), Row 163 (daily Stripe/bank/entitlement reconciliation), or a qualified tax professional.

monthlyCloseChecklist.name: Freeze the close period
actions: Name the period (YYYY-MM) and cutoff timestamp
Confirm Row 163 daily recon exists through cutoff, or record that daily recon is missing and treat the month as exception-held
Do not include post-cutoff activity in the period pack

monthlyCloseChecklist.name: Reconcile bank accounts
monthlyCloseChecklist.founderAction: Export operating, tax-reserve, and payment-settlement statements from the bank (Founder-held login). Do not store credentials in the repo.
actions: Match every bank line to a book entry or documented exception
Confirm Stripe payouts landing in the payment-settlement account equal Stripe payout reports for the period
Confirm tax-reserve transfers are balance-sheet movements, not operating expense
Record bank fees in the Row 11 bank-fee category
monthlyCloseChecklist.doneWhen: Bank rec shows $0 unexplained difference for each account.

monthlyCloseChecklist.name: Reconcile Stripe
monthlyCloseChecklist.imaniRole: Supply non-secret payment/fee/payout extracts from authorized systems. Do not mutate Stripe config.
actions: Gross charges by offer against locked catalog: Blueprint $500 one-time (50_000 cents), Founding Architect $750 one-time (75_000 cents), Community $50/month (5_000 cents). Do not use stale $1,500 / $1,750.

If a collected Stripe amount differs from locked 50_000 / 75_000 / 5_000 cents, log an exception. Do not treat stale $1,500/$1,750 list prices as the books standard. Do not create, remap, or mutate Stripe Price IDs from this row.
Processing fees (Stripe): record as payment-processing expense, not as a reduction of list price in customer-facing copy
Payouts: Stripe payouts vs bank deposits (step 2)
Failed payments: no revenue; confirm entitlements were not granted or were revoked per billing reconcile
Disputes/chargebacks: record contra-revenue or liability even though public policy is no refunds; cancellation is not a refund
Refunds: standard policy is no refunds; if a Founder-authorized exception occurs, record it and do not change public policy from this close
Do not treat sandbox/test charges as books
monthlyCloseChecklist.doneWhen: Stripe gross, fees, payouts, and dispute/exception items reconciling to bank and to Row 163 daily recon.

monthlyCloseChecklist.name: Categorize expenses
actions: Code every expense to the Row 11 chart of accounts (do not maintain a second chart in this file)

Map known launch vendors from ops/fab-5/vendor-saas-register.json: Vercel hosting, Supabase database, Google Workspace email, OpenAI Fab 5 cycles, Cursor engineering, GitHub source, domain/DNS, HeyGen pre-rendered media (non-runtime), Stripe processing fees
Instagram/TikTok: record paid spend if any; organic social is not an invented expense
Insurance: Founder elected to launch without business insurance; record $0 unless a policy is later bound
Spend Class B/C stays inside the approved $5,000 launch cap; Class D unbudgeted spend is Founder-gated and must appear as an exception if it occurred
monthlyCloseChecklist.doneWhen: Every period expense has a category, vendor, amount, date, and receipt or documented missing-receipt exception.

monthlyCloseChecklist.name: Record fees and liabilities
actions: Stripe processing fees
Bank fees
Accrued vendor SaaS only if Row 11 method is accrual; otherwise record when paid
Sales/use tax payable only if a qualified advisor has determined an amount — do not invent nexus or rates
Estimated income-tax reserve: transfer to tax-reserve account per Founder; Michelle tracks, Founder moves cash
Chargeback/dispute reserves as identified
Deferred/unearned revenue treatment for Community subscriptions and Founding Architect included months is a qualified-advisor decision, not an agent invention
monthlyCloseChecklist.doneWhen: Fee and liability accounts match source reports and advisor-approved treatment.

monthlyCloseChecklist.name: Preserve receipts
actions: Every vendor invoice, Stripe fee report, bank statement, and payout report for the period is stored in the Founder-held receipt store
Do not commit receipts, card numbers, bank statements with account numbers, or API keys to git
Close pack contains an index (vendor, date, amount, category, evidence location) not the images/PDFs
Retention follows the tax calendar / qualified advisor; do not invent a conflicting retention rule here
monthlyCloseChecklist.doneWhen: Receipt index is complete; missing items are listed as exceptions with Founder owner and due date.

monthlyCloseChecklist.name: Produce P&L, balance sheet, and cash view
outputs: Profit and loss for the period and YTD
Balance sheet as of cutoff (cash by account, receivables if any, liabilities, tax reserve)
Cash view: opening cash, inflows (Stripe payouts / other), outflows (vendors, fees, tax-reserve transfers), closing cash, reconciling to bank
monthlyCloseChecklist.doneWhen: Three statements exist, tie to recon, and use Row 11 accounts.

monthlyCloseChecklist.name: Review budget variance
actions: Launch window: actual spend vs approved $5,000 launch budget cap (August Launch row 3). Do not invent other dollar thresholds.
After launch budget is exhausted or post-launch operating budget exists: variance vs that budget
Explain material over/under by vendor and spend class (A/B/C/D)
Unbudgeted spend is not closed silently — escalate to Founder
monthlyCloseChecklist.doneWhen: Variance sheet is attached and every Class D item is Founder-visible.

monthlyCloseChecklist.name: Resolve or hold exceptions
holdCloseIf: Any bank or Stripe unexplained difference remains
Live vs test Stripe activity cannot be distinguished
Row 11 accounts are missing so categorization cannot be evidenced
A Founder-reserved tax or spend decision is required and is open
Gross charges use a list price other than locked $500 / $750 / $50 and the difference is unexplained
actions: Log each exception with owner, amount if known, due date, and whether the close is HELD or CERTIFIED WITH EXCEPTION
Chargebacks: Founder + Imani evidence path; no public refund promise
Do not mark the month certified while a hold condition is open

monthlyCloseChecklist.name: Certify books ready for tax reporting
actions: Michelle presents the close pack and exception log
Kimberly Walker (human) certifies or rejects
Certification means: period reconciling, receipts preserved, statements produced, variance reviewed, remaining exceptions listed, pack ready for qualified tax/accountant handoff
Certification is not a tax filing and is not attorney/CPA advice
Do not treat Kimberly Walker (AI) as certifier
monthlyCloseChecklist.doneWhen: Founder certification recorded with period, date, and exception list. Post Launch 'Monthly Financial Close and Tax Readiness' may then run for that month.

closePackContents: Period cover sheet (entity, period, cutoff, owners, certification status)
Stripe reconciliation (gross by offer, fees, payouts, failed payments, disputes/chargebacks, authorized exceptions)
Receipt index (no secrets, no full account numbers)
Budget variance vs $5,000 launch cap or successor operating budget
